notes.title: The free trial demo of 'Fantasy Encountering Emperor Qin Shi Huang' has been rel
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45308095/d65df20000f7657197d7189ac41a3cc64538a698.jpg[/img]


Hello everyone, this is Red Bean~

The free trial demo of 'Fantasy Encountering Emperor Qin Shi Huang' has been released! Welcome to try it out~

In this free demo, you will experience:

The story content from the prologue to the beginning of the fourth chapter of the game, with a script of approximately 180000 words.

One theme song and two beautiful male lead insert songs.

It includes a death by mistake ending, two side endings, and a male lead TE ending.

The following content has not been unlocked in the demo version, please look forward to experiencing it in the official version——

More than 500000 words of exciting plot throughout the entire book.

21 independent endings.

The full value chapter channel has not been unlocked yet.

Please join the wish list and look forward to the complete version together!

notes.title: The store page of "Fantasy: Meet the First Emperor of Qin" has been released!
notes.content:
The store page of "Fantasy: Meet the First Emperor of Qin" has been released!

Hello everyone, this is Red Bean

The store page for the STEAM version of "Fantasy: Meet the First Emperor of Qin" is now live!
This is a love story about a high school girl who travels back in time to the Spring and Autumn Period in China. I hope you will enjoy it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45308095/191e8ba5a540149686c2e0a7027518be52109b9b.jpg[/img]


The demo version is expected to be released before the end of 2024, and we hope to release more content for free trial.
The official version, which is also the full story, is expected to be released in the first half of 2025.

If you are interested in the game, please add it to your wish list!

Thank you all

Producer Red Bean
November 22, 2024
